title: Hearing a white orchestra at Bishop's Cafe
summary: Helping the busboy so he can hang around the dining room, he hears his first real orchestra with violins and horns.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And so anyway, my brother went on, and while I was working there, while I was a dishwasher--well actually, I did not go in the dining room, but after a while the busboy would (inaudible). So this guy, I don't know where he was from, he didn't know what to call it, I don't know what kind of name they called that orchestra, but finally I said to them, I'll tell you what, when I get through I'm going to help you get your dishes out of the dining room. He said okay. I got through with mine right quick and I said man, that's an orchestra. He said I didn't know what you were talking about.
This orchestra was playing at Bishops?
And so then this was the most beautiful music that I heard. That little country music around Taft and Muskogee, but I never heard anything like that and they had violins
and everything and horns. I would always rush. Then we got to be pretty tight, this busboy, and he would help me and I'd get through and then I'd help him get his dishes.
Yes; so I could hang around the dining room and hear the band.
